description: No schedule, one PR at a time, merged by GitHub auto-merge once the CI `build` check passes

packageRules.description: Follow serversideup's release tags for the newest PHP 8.x FrankenPHP on Alpine (8-frankenphp-alpine-v5.1.5 to -v5.2.0); a new PHP minor arrives with an ordinary release or digest update; betas and the per-PHP-patch tags don't match and are ignored. The digest update catches rebuilds of the same tag.
A new serversideup major release can rename settings or change its Caddyfile: open the PR but merge it by hand
